notes:
Top-line: mid-market PM SaaS evaluating Redwood with initial Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb) -> moving to Dedicated for production tenant isolation and predictable latency. Team is product-led; feature: in-app chat + doc search + personalized snippets. CTO (A. Rivera) emphasized: 'We need explicit SLA guarantees before we move off hosted.'

POC summary: Hosted API used for two-week experiment (chat flows + embeddings). Metrics: 95p latency ~ 280ms on hosted for typical chat (seq len 512), cost per 1M tokens within expectations. POC flagged model selection: prefer llama-derivative 13B quantized variant but want Redwood to validate quant perf on Dedicated.

Procurement/legal: now in active redline phase. Legal submitted MSA + DPA with standard mid-market edits (limitation of liability, data deletion timeline, incident notification SLA). Wildwood's security team asked for: audit log retention 12 months (want ability to query), guaranteed KMS integration, and EU data residency for EU customers. Redwood's standard DPA flagged in-house; Wildwood pushing for tighter data deletion language.

Operational asks from Eng: mount Dedicated in single-tenant pool with VPC peering to our infra (AWS eu-west-1 and us-east-1), can Redwood support multi-region failover? Need confirmation on autoscaling burst behavior and lead times for capacity increases. Also asking for per-route model pinning and automatic fallback to cheaper variant when capacity constrained.

Sales notes / pricing convo: AE provided committed-capacity pricing options in deck (see drive link). Finance wants 12-month commit; final ARR range estimate $120k-$250k depending on quantization/caching options. Request for a carve-out on ramp credits to offset migration costs.

Quotes from stakeholders: CTO: 'If we can get the SLA and DPA language aligned, this goes to procurement immediately.' Product lead: 'Key metric is median + 95p response time — product UX can't tolerate >200ms 95p for short assistant flows.'

Short-term next steps: legal redline pass due 2026-03-10, SE to run Dedicated perf run (model/quant combo) week of 2026-03-08, finalize pricing term sheet, procurement review 2026-03-15.

Misc: created POC Jira RDW-1198 for perf regressions; security review doc in drive (see link).
